title: 3 stars, but you might receive a better one than me
text:
3 stars, but you might receive a better one than me. [[VIDEOID:1ec2c5c03f18c09cfcc338eaa9825c45]] The stainless steel is nicely polished and I love the 40L size!
However, on mine the lid does not shut flush in the back.
Then, mine came with a broken black basket.
Nonetheless, you might receive a better one than mine.
The stainless steel is thick and won’t dent easily.
It seems like it could be a really good trash can!

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)

product_metadata.title: Flash Furniture Round Stainless Steel Imprint Resistant Soft Close, Step Trash Can -3.2 Gallons (12L)
features: It's the everyday things in life that can either be completely annoying or simple and easy. This trash can has great looks, smooth movement and when you add in the removable bucket, taking out the trash has never been more painless.
Attractive Design: Fingerprint resistant stainless steel exterior, soft close lid
Hygienic: Foot pedal eliminates the need to touch germ riddled surfaces
Instant Use: For your convenience, no assembly is required
PRODUCT MEASUREMENTS: Overall Size: 10"W x 12"D x 15.5"H Closed - 24"H Open; Removable Liner: 9.25"W x 9.25"D x 12.5"H
description: When you need a place for refuse and space is at a premium, this round stainless steel, step trash can is a lifesaver. Compact in design, this bin fits well in bathrooms, bedrooms, offices or wherever room is limited. The stainless steel finish is fingerprint resistant which prevents smudges to keep the can looking shiny and new. Hygienic in use, the foot pedal allows you to keep your hands clean and sanitized which is important in stopping the spread of germs. The soft close lid keeps the lid from slamming down for a silent close. The lid closes firmly to keep pets out of trash helping you avoid messes and prevents them from bringing you embarrassing gifts when you have visitors. Use this receptacle as is next to your desk for paper waste or add a bag liner for messier locations. The removable bucket makes it a breeze to remove your trash. Best of all, there is no assembly required. Simply remove the can from the box and place it wherever you wish.
